messages:
maya: Hey team — PR 8471 fixes a KV-cache OOM we saw in prod. Cutoff for tonight's hotfix is in 45m, need 2x LGTM to merge and trigger the canary. PR: https://git.company/repo/pull/8471

ashok: Pinged the release owners. Quick Q: does this change any on-disk format or require migration?

maya: No on-disk changes, purely in-memory guard and tighter kv eviction. No migration.

sam: I can take a look now. If it’s just eviction tweaks, should be small. Any smoke test results?

maya: Staging smoke passed — I ran a 10m load with the repro, no OOM, peak mem ~78% of baseline. Snippet of the smoke-start command:```bash
./smoke_test --duration 600 --workload kv-heavy --concurrency 50
```

ashok: Can you paste the relevant log lines showing eviction kicking in? helps reviewers.

maya: Sure — pasted below:```
[2026-03-15T21:12:33Z] kv: evicting 128 entries, freed 45MB
[2026-03-15T21:12:33Z] kv: current_mem=1.9GB threshold=2.0GB
```

release-bot: Reminder — hotfix merge window closes at 22:30 UTC. If merged, canary rollout at +10m.

taylor: Looking now. Two quick things I care about: (1) does this interact with the async prefetch path, (2) rollback plan if canary regresses?

maya: (1) Prefetch path stays untouched. (2) Rollback is standard: abort canary and autobackout to previous release, plus an immediate rebuild to include a revert patch if needed. Ops runbook linked: https://wiki/company/release-runbook#autobackout

sam: Found a flaky unit test related to eviction TTL — pushed tiny fix to the PR branch (one-liner). Running CI again.

ashok: Thanks. I'll review the final diff once CI turns green. If the fix is small, I'm okay giving LGTM after a quick scan.

devon: Adding a note — if canary sees degraded latency, we should have the fallback routing to the lower-memory model ready. I've pre-warmed the variant.

maya: Awesome, thanks @devon. That fallback is in the rollback checklist.

(tiny pause, CI green)

sam: CI ✅. Smoke logs attached in the PR. I left a minor comment about a log level; not blocking.

taylor: Read through. Code reads clean, eviction heuristics look sensible. Two nits about docstrings. Not blocking. LGTM from me. :thumbsup:

ashok: Scanned the patch and smoke output. No migration, no perf regressions in staging. LGTM.

maya: Thanks both — merging after one more ops thumbs?

devon: Ops thumbs — will watch canary and be ready to back out. :eyes:

maya: Merged. Canary started (canary-42). Monitoring channel: #canary-watch.

release-bot: Canary rollout started for release hotfix-2026-03-15-2. Autoscale-enabled: true.

taylor: I'll keep an eye on latency dashboards for the next 30m. Good catch, everyone.

maya: Closing thread — will open a follow-up if anything odd comes up. Thanks!
